subject.title: [Feature]: Memory/Context Improvements (metrics + global semantic search + conversation chaining + preload on restart)

question: Should OpenClaw define core-supported surfaces for agent-facing metrics, cross-session semantic recall, normal-session handoff, and restart preload, or keep some of these as experimental/plugin-owned capabilities?
rationale: The code supports adjacent pieces, but the remaining behavior sets API shape, defaults, transcript/docs visibility, auth/cost attribution, and gateway lifecycle policy that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Split Into Design Tracks
options.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella and split metrics, memory search scope, session continuation, and restart-preload decisions into narrow product/security issues before implementation.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Continue using this issue as the coordination point until maintainers are ready to design the remaining surfaces together.

options.title: Defer Broad Expansion
options.body: Let narrower reliability and sessionMemory issues proceed while explicitly deferring the grouped API/default expansion for now.

recommendation.title: Split Into Design Tracks
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella and split metrics, memory search scope, session continuation, and restart-preload decisions into narrow product/security issues before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete posted the prior keep-open review and has the strongest combined history across the memory, usage, and docs surfaces.
